# Tan Gemicioglu

> Official personal website and research portfolio of Tan Gemicioglu, a PhD candidate at Cornell Tech working across wearable computing, human-computer interaction, physiological sensing, haptics, and AI.

This site contains research publications, project descriptions, software, essays, and a curriculum vitae. Project pages distinguish completed studies from prototypes, coursework, simulations, and ongoing work; preserve those qualifications when summarizing results.

## Core pages

- [About](https://tangemicioglu.com/): Current research focus, affiliation, background, and news.
- [Publications](https://tangemicioglu.com/publications/): Peer-reviewed papers and research outputs, with authors, venues, abstracts, DOI links, and PDFs where available.
- [Projects](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/): Research, software, independent work, and coursework, with methods, results, limitations, and primary sources.
- [Writing](https://tangemicioglu.com/writing/): Essays and project notes.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://tangemicioglu.com/cv/): Browser page for the current CV.
- [Curriculum vitae PDF](https://tangemicioglu.com/files/CV.pdf): Complete CV document.

## Selected research and systems

- [AppetiteCheck](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/tvns-appetite-modulation/): Momentary non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation as a low-attention intervention during eating.
- [BionicFace](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/bionicface/): Ongoing work on wearable sensing and stimulation for chronic facial paralysis.
- [BreathePulse](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/breathepulse/): Peripheral breathing guidance through subtle airflow cues.
- [Passive Haptic Rehearsal](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/passive-haptic-learning-piano/): Tactile rehearsal between active piano-practice sessions.
- [SilentSpeller](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/silentspeller/): Mobile silent-speech text entry using electropalatography.
- [Tongue gestures in head-worn devices](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/tongue-gestures-in-hwds/): Multimodal recognition and gaze confirmation using closed-mouth tongue gestures.
- [EchoForce](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/echoforce/): Continuous grip-force estimation from forearm skin deformation using active acoustic sensing.
- [BrainBraille](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/brainbraille/): Spatially coded mental gestures for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
- [ITR Atlas](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/itr-atlas/): Re-derived communication-throughput comparisons across human-computer and brain-computer interfaces.
- [Wardian](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/wardian/): A local-first, malleable desktop habitat for durable agent work.
- [OpenRing Companion](https://tangemicioglu.com/projects/openring-companion/): An open-source companion application for OpenRing wearables.
